parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL647319' to activities on assay_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to exact measurements: standard_relation = '=', standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
